name: Bangumi

versions.changelog:
## 兼容性说明

为了避免升级 Jellyfin 12 后可能与 Jellyfin 10.11 不兼容的情况，保留此版本作为 Jellyfin 10.11 的最后一个版本。

后续插件将不再考虑 Jellyfin 10.11 的兼容性，若出现不兼容情况，可以下载此版本。

## 新功能与改进

- 增加按用户管理 Bangumi 授权，以及 NSFW 播放记录的私密上报选项。
- 增加缺失 Bangumi ID 的补全工具和 `bangumi.ini` 媒体库管理功能，改进批量选择及刷新反馈。
- 增加动画搜索偏好和优先使用原始标题搜索的配置，支持自定义 Bangumi 网站地址。
- 引入 Anitomy 剧集解析器，改进文件名、集数和多季度识别。
- 增强音乐元数据与播放记录同步，调整插件设置页面。

## 问题修复

- 修复 Bangumi 图片地址和搜索结果处理问题。
- 修复剧集与季度未读取 `bangumi.ini`、未知季度和重复剧集扫描中的特别篇识别问题。
- 修复音乐刮削中的元数据丢失及艺人类型筛选问题。
- 修复 infobox 解析死循环及重复字段处理。
- 改进异步请求、取消操作、评分刷新和播放状态缓存处理。

**完整更新记录**：https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.6...1.7.7

## New Features 增加了重复剧集检测小工具，用于替换字幕组、发布 V2 版时自动清理旧版本 ## What's Changed * fix: handle null and empty ChineseName correctly by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/232 * fix: Emby plugin support for macOS ARM and .NET 6 runtime by @nihs903222 in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/233 * fix: implement IHasSupportedExternalIdentifiers for Emby by @sjtuross in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/236 * 修复Subject的PersonInfos或Characters拉取失败导致整个Subject的元数据拉取失败的问题 by @HydrogensaysHDT in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/238 ## New Contributors * @nihs903222 made their first contribution in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/233 * @sjtuross made their first contribution in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/236 * @HydrogensaysHDT made their first contribution in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/238 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.5...1.7.6

## What's Changed
* 支持人物搜索
* 为 Emby 添加 bangumi.ini 支持 by @luoboQAQ in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/224
* 优化 markdown 换行转换，对于不支持 markdown 显示的第三方播放器更友好
* 修复元数据中 `Bangumi ID` 显示为 `Bangumi 专辑 ID` 的问题
* 修复插件配置目录不存在导致的登录失败 #218
* 添加了插件 logo 图（改自 https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/4455303 ）

## New Contributors
* @luoboQAQ made their first contribution in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/224

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.4...1.7.5

修复 Jellyfin 10.11.0 中遇到的一些小问题

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.3...1.7.4

## 支持 Jellyfin 10.11

注：如需使用 10.10 及更早的版本，请到 Release 中下载老版本

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.2...1.7.3

注：这可能是最后一个支持 Jellyfin 10.10 的版本，目前看来 Jellyfin 10.11 API 有变化，待正式版发布后插件会及时适配

## What's Changed
* fix: More robust error message matching by @RandomNamer in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/195
* feat: add collection by subject's relation by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/160
* feat: add ui for controlling rating refresh intervals by @RandomNamer in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/203
* feat: try match following seasons by name when first season is not pr… by @RandomNamer in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/202
* Fix：部分文件季号刮削错误 by @wsgh0202 in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/208
* refactor: separate the basic parser by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/163
* refactor: extract local configuration handling to LocalConfigurationH… by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/210

## New Contributors
* @wsgh0202 made their first contribution in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/208

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.1...1.7.2

## What's Changed

- 优化离线数据库更新逻辑
- 近期放送的剧集始终使用在线 API 获取

# Self Service: 

* Users can link existing jellyfin accounts to SSO provider accounts
* Users can remove existing links
* Users can configure multiple SSO provider accounts
* Account names no longer have to match across Jellyfin -> SSO provider
  * Eg, can link google OIDC, with a `sub` of `asfbeausfahgajsfjasd-ugly-sub` to jellyfin username `matthew`

## What's Changed

### Features

* Implement Canonical Linking + Self Service by @matthewstrasiotto in https://github.com/9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso/pull/34
   * Account names no longer have to match to be linked

### Fixes

* Fix ID Provider incorrectly resetting on login by @matthewstrasiotto in https://github.com/9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso/pull/33

## Features
- Shadows, rules, and the Frame border now scale with the poster, so they read the same on a 4K frame as on a DVD rip instead of turning into a hairline or a slab
- Long titles that do not fit two lines fill the first line with whole words and trim only the second, at a word boundary, instead of cutting both lines mid-word

## Fixes
- Frame drew no border at all for an episode without a name, and ignored the Show Title setting
- Cutout no longer lets a two line title run into the bottom of the cutout letters
- Split center-crops the series poster into its panel instead of stretching artwork that is not 2:3
- Brush honours the Show Episode setting and keeps a wrapped title inside the area the strokes leave clear
- Timeline keeps the marker dot inside the safe area on the first and last episode
- Text blocks are reserved from the font's real ascent and descent, so descenders no longer hang past the safe area

## Developer
- Built against the SkiaSharp 3.119.4 and Microsoft.Extensions 10.0.11 packages Jellyfin 12.0 ships, since the plugin binds to the server's copies at runtime
- Text drawing moved from the removed SKPaint text members to SKFont, wrapped in a shared TextStyle so every style measures and draws with the same objects
- Standard and Split share one text stack; Numeral, Cutout, Brush, and Frame no longer hand-build their own paints
- Cutout renders through a canvas layer instead of a full-size scratch bitmap per poster; Split and Brush dispose their gradient shaders
- Letterbox detection scans the pixel buffer directly instead of a native call per pixel
- Bitmap scaling uses explicit cubic resampling now that FilterQuality is gone

## Developer
- Rebuilt for Jellyfin 12.0 on .NET 10, with the target ABI raised to 12.0.0.0
- The dashboard menu entry now shows a icon instead of the generic folder
- CI builds, tests, and CodeQL now run on .NET 10, and label sync has the token scope it needs

## Features
- Generated posters now appear in the episodes Edit Images dialog, so you can pick the frame you want instead of refreshing until you get a good one
- Choose how many alternate posters to offer in Edit Images, from 1 to 10 (default 3)
- Brush style can outline its stroke, sharing the Cutout styles outline toggle
- Element Spacing setting controls the gap between stacked poster elements, so every style spaces them the same way
- The font dropdown now lists the fonts actually installed on your server, and a font that is not installed is called out in the log instead of silently rendering in a substitute face
- Overlay colors collapse to an opacity control when Palette-Derived Colors is on, since the color itself comes from the image

## Breaking
- The scheduled task has been removed. Poster generation now runs entirely as a metadata provider - use a library metadata refresh, or pick a poster from Edit Images
- Processing history and its database have been removed, along with the Reset Processing History button. Jellyfins own refresh options now decide what gets regenerated

## Fixes
- Deleting an episode poster no longer left it permanently blank; there is no tracking state left to say the episode was already done
- Changing a custom font now takes effect; it used to be left out of the change detection entirely
- A tall logo no longer overlaps the episode code beneath it
- Long episode titles wrap to two lines again instead of being shortened to one
- Short titles no longer leave a gap between the episode code and the title
- Cancelling a refresh now stops frame extraction instead of letting it run to completion
- Generated posters are no longer written to the transcode directory and left behind
- Aspect ratios like 2.35:1 now parse correctly on servers with a comma decimal separator
- Saving the Posters tab no longer hangs on a spinner when the save fails, and no longer overwrites the settings on the other tab
- Settings added in a newer version no longer break saving for configurations written by an older one

## Developer
- The frosted panel shape and the brush stroke paths are disposed even when an exception unwinds
- Poster elements are positioned by a shared measure-then-place layout column instead of each style walking its own offsets, and titles are fitted to the height they are given as well as the width
- Poster configuration is never written back during plugin startup, so a failed config load can no longer overwrite good settings with defaults
- Poster rendering returns encoded bytes rather than temp files
- Removed the scheduled task, tracking database, configuration hashing, and around 900 lines of superseded code
- Shaders, mask filters, and image filters are disposed rather than left to finalization; HDR brightening no longer round-trips the whole bitmap through managed memory
- Example templates carry every current setting, and the bundled examples were regenerated
- Test suite grown from 21 to 39 cases, covering layout, title fitting, aspect ratio parsing, font resolution, and the generated image cache
- Bump Base to 2026.7.31

## Developer

## Fixes
- Remove backdrops before using the current extracted frame as the new backdrop to prevent image bloat

## Fixes
- Frame seeking starts from a random phase each run, so refreshing an episode image picks a new frame instead of the same one

## Features
- Abbreviate tries the text before a divider, then the first sentence, then initials with periods

## Fixes

## Features

Same plugin as v12.0.1.0 - no functional changes. It exists so that servers
upgraded from Jellyfin 10.11 to Jellyfin 12 automatically pick up the correct
build.

Bug Fixes:
- Upgrading Jellyfin from 10.11 to 12 left the plugin showing "Not supported".
  Each release published its 10.11 and its 12 build under the same version
  number, so a server that had installed the 10.11 build kept it after the
  upgrade - Jellyfin saw no newer version to offer, and the 10.11 build cannot
  run on Jellyfin 12. This release is published for Jellyfin 12 only, so those
  servers now see an update and repair themselves. Jellyfin 10.11 servers are
  unaffected and stay on v12.0.1.0.

Full changelog: https://jellyfin-smartlists-plugin.dinsten.se/changelog/stable/

The first stable release for Jellyfin 12, and the biggest update yet - 22 release
candidates of work since v10.11.30.2. Jellyfin 10.11 is still fully supported.

Jellyfin 12:
- Full support for Jellyfin 12, including the final 12.0.0 release
- Jellyfin 10.11 continues to receive the same updates

New features:
- List templates: one-click starting points on the Create tab

- Group results into collections: turn an item search into a collection of collections
- Collection and Playlist media types: build collections of collections or playlists
- Smart collections now carry genres, studios, parental rating and total runtime
- Smart list badge on generated covers, with a setting to turn it off
- Integration API so other tools can create and manage smart lists
- Bumpers, and random group selection
- New rule field: User Rating
- Date rules can include items whose date is missing from metadata
- New settings for default media types and for hiding new lists when empty

External lists:
- New providers: ListenBrainz and Scrob
- Music lists match tracks via MusicBrainz, one library item per matched track
- User-Agent setting for when a provider starts blocking requests

Sorting:
- Least Recently Watched Round Robin, and Shuffled Round Robin
- Round Robin can group by Collection and order items within each group
- Crossover episodes that aired close together play back-to-back, with an Air Window setting
- Play Count (all users) and Last Played (all users)

Improvements:
- Large speed-up for expensive rules - people, languages, resolution and more are read once per refresh
- Parent tags, studios and genres are found at every level above an item, including the library
- Only fully watched episodes advance the Least Recently Watched rotation
- Weekly cleanup removes leftover playlists and collections whose list is gone
- Rule groups are named consistently throughout; the sort option is now Rule Group Order

Bug fixes:
- Titles containing numbers sort correctly - "Season 2" before "Season 10"
- The Resolution sort did nothing and left lists sorted by name
- Episodes came back unordered when Season/Episode was combined with another sort
- A series showed a play count of 0 even when every episode was watched
- Items with no release date no longer match "before", "older than" and "not equals"
- IMDb lists, charts and awards failed to load with a "Forbidden" error
- Configuration pages loaded blank behind a reverse proxy, or with Cloudflare Rocket Loader
- Smart collections disappeared when the TMDbBoxSets plugin was installed
- Duplicates left behind by a failed deletion are detected and cleaned up
- List names can contain : * ? < > | " / and \ again
- Saving a list now reports why it failed instead of appearing to do nothing
- A failed save no longer discards what you typed
- Deleting a list right after editing it no longer brings it back

Existing lists may change:
- Rules checking parent values now look at every level above an item, so they match more
- Music lists are the most visible case: artist folder and library values now count
- Similar To applies within its own rule group instead of filtering the whole list
- Smart collections now carry aggregated genres/studios/runtime, so other lists may match them
- Include-only checkboxes are migrated automatically to Name rules

- Support for **Collections** has been added.

- A **status page** has been added
- And **many** other backend changes

### Breaking changes

- The legacy Jellyfin tasks have been removed. Make sure no playlists are using these, and if so, set a custom schedule for them instead.

If you encounter issues where the plugin is stuck in a restart loop because of the name change, uninstall the plugin, remove the SmartPlaylist folder (there might be two, remove both) from your Jellyfin plugin folder, reboot Jellyfin and then install the plugin again

versions.changelog: Restores intended 'new' mode behaviour to filter recent movies and series with episodes released within a selected time period..
Adds hero mode, improved consistency and predictability of new mode, and added gentle animation to banner images.

Compatible with Jellyfin 10.11.0.

Updates compatability with FileTransformation. Fixes bug where un-rated items don't show despite minimum rating filter set to zero. Fixes bug loading on some TVs, adds option to hide slider on TV mode.

Improves function of 'new mode'. TV shows with an end date within the selected time period will be included. Restores 'open in new tab' ability to slider. Replaces 1.3.1.0 release which also: Improves FileTransformation mode reliability, adds heading option, and adds more options to 'New' mode
Adds integration with the FileTransformation plugin for easier installation.
Adds options to exclude played items, and configure the height of the slider.
Stylistic corrections and compatability with ElegantFin.
Re-release of 1.1.0.1 to fix versioning. Removes image resizing as default to improve plugin performance.
Adds new 'recent releases' mode, localisation for 'Watch' button, option to change autoplay interval, and options to show description and rating or not.
Adds parental rating filtering.
Fixes issues on TV mode.
New and improved slider! Including autoplay, looping, and improved loading reliability
Compatability with Jellygin 10.10.6
Allows filtering by library, adds 'Collections' mode, speeds up load times, and improves config UI
Allows filtering by minimum community or critic rating! And fixes slider on Jellyfin Android app
This version greatly improves the mechanism to load the slider, so that it is faster and more reliable.

Now works with Jellyfin 10.10.x. Other changes in this version include: Users can now only see items from libraries that they have permission to access. The option to show a particular number of items applies to 'favourites' mode as well as random mode. Slider will not show IMDB ratings if unavailable. Scroller buttons adjusted to stand out more on light background.

name: Moonbase
overview: Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin with web app hosting, settings sync, theming, and Seerr integrations
description:
Moonbase is the Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin, powering settings sync, the Moonfin Web app at /Moonfin/Web/, a built-in theme editor with custom theme APIs, media bar and ratings integrations, and Seerr proxy/SSO with admin defaults and broadcasts across Moonfin clients.  
  
Universal Repo:  
Generated: 20:28 UTC  
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin/refs/heads/master/manifest.json  
Github: https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin

versions.changelog:
Moonbase 2.2.0 adds server messages, so an admin can write something once and have it show up in people's apps even when they were offline while it was sent. The admin defaults page grows a lot, with settings for another 96 options and fixes to the six controls that were writing values no client reads. Retro games find more of their artwork, and it now picks up new ROMs without a restart. A reinstalled Seerr no longer strands you logged out, and a zipped game now arrives as the ROM it actually is. The bundled web client moves up to Moonfin 2.5.1.

Features:

- A new Messages tab lets an admin write a message with a title and a Markdown body, pick a colour, choose how it shows up, pick who sees it, schedule a start and end date, add a link button, and order the list. Broadcast now saves what it sends, so a user who was offline still finds it.
- Admin defaults picked up settings for another 96 options, covering discovery rows, Since You Watched, music rows, sort direction for the home rows, player buttons, media segments, Cinema Mode for episodes, and a lot more.
- Six admin controls that were writing values no client reads now send the right ones, and row sorting was rebuilt to match the clients, which also adds the missing Playlist Order option.
- Retro games now watch the configured game library folders for file changes, so a new ROM or a per-library scan runs artwork reconciliation in the background instead of waiting for a restart, and games that came out as a false miss are retried once the matching has corrected them.
- The settings sync toggle was renamed to Moonbase Sync, and its description now says that enabling it is required for the Seerr and ratings integrations.
- The bundled web client picks up everything web relevant from Moonfin 2.5.1, including the messages window, a Seerr poster grid with a download progress bar, remote subtitle badges, Play and Resume on the long press menu, and personal ratings writing to Emby.

Bug Fixes:

- A reinstalled Seerr no longer strands you logged out. The plugin was reading every 403 as missing admin rights, so the stale session was never cleared. Now it checks whether Seerr still knows the session first, and a definite refusal clears the old session and signs in again.
- A zipped game now arrives as the ROM it actually is. The detail was naming the archive, so a client saved plain ROM bytes under a .zip name and failed to unpack them. It now names the file the endpoint actually sends, along with its real size.
- A pending artwork timer can no longer take the process down on shutdown, and the artwork delivery route rejects an unknown role instead of falling through.
- The websocket reconnects after a server restart, a busy server no longer reads as a connection timeout, and Escape closes the dialog on top instead of the page behind it.

Moonbase 2.1.0 is mostly about the retro games backend, plus a personal ratings API, audiobook bookmark sync, and the bundled Moonfin web app at 2.5.0.

Features:

- Retro games: arcade ZIPs are validated offline against FBNeo and MAME DAT files, and admins can upload a DAT per core through the plugin.
- Retro games: ROMs are identified by their contents through the libretro RDB databases, with per game core and backend overrides.
- Retro games: a server side artwork pipeline with a manifest, per game artwork priority, and cached thumbnails at the requested size and format. Reconciliation runs on plugin startup and after every library scan.
- Retro games: delivery and per user concurrency limiters, a real Moonfin bridge for the EmulatorJS web player, and archive hashing capped at 512 MB per entry.
- A personal ratings endpoint serves the calling user's ratings in one response, so clients can sort and filter libraries by them.
- Audiobook bookmarks and notes are stored on the server and synced between clients.
- Clients can read their own transcode jobs, so transcoded downloads show real progress and an ETA.
- Settings sync covers everything Moonfin 2.5.0 added: HDR subtitle style, per segment skip actions, home row sort orders, the Studios row, spoiler free toggles, personal rating style, media type badges, segment auto hide, swipe gestures, scroll sensitivity, Cinema Mode for episodes, external trailers, and the crash report toggle.
- Admin defaults page: home row toggles with per row sorting defaults, Seerr Watchlist and Seerr shortcuts rows, the Aya media bar style, a Recently Released series type default, and pushing a genre, collection, or playlist row now enables its category toggle.
- The plugin reports itself as Moonbase throughout the dashboard.

Bug Fixes:

- TV studios get their logos, since TMDB networks are now read alongside production companies. Network ids are namespaced apart from company ids and the logo cache index is versioned.
- Seerr provisioning reports why it stopped instead of a bare status.
- IMDb charts stopped returning 403.
- Admin defaults: browsing and details blur defaults no longer fail the whole save, the theme music volume default is saved, and the Continue Watching image type options send values the client understands.

Web App:

- Bundles Moonfin 2.5.0 with the first run setup wizard, the Aya media bar, the full set of library sorts and filters, personal ratings, Seerr browse shortcuts, a Live TV favorites row, a Studio row, Live TV series recording, spoiler free toggles, an expanded metadata editor, Vim style playback keys, per segment skip actions, an HDR subtitle style, and crash reports sent to your own server.
- Fixes for playback control flicker, the skip button, subtitle offset range, Seerr row hover and localization, Continue Watching and Next Up paging, library search with Group By, blurry search posters, context menu placement, studio logo matching, media bar gradient flashing, backdrop fades, source pickers losing ids, book summaries, right to left layouts, and internationalized server domain names.

Features:

- Added a Playback tab to the admin defaults page, covering autoplay, audio and subtitle language, subtitle mode, skip lengths, intro action, still watching behavior, Next Up timeout, and rewind durations.
- Added default pickers for Action Buttons and Seerr Discovery row order.
- Added profile properties for OLED mode, the player time labels, and the new home row options, so those settings sync between devices.
- Game ROM and BIOS routes answer HEAD requests, which is how clients check a file's size before downloading it.

Bug Fixes:

- The Playback admin tab now writes the keys, values, and units clients actually read. Several pickers were saving under names no client looked for, so those defaults silently did nothing.
- Resume Rewind and Unpause Rewind options match what the client offers, instead of listing durations it has no setting for.
- Removed admin controls that no longer map to anything a client syncs. The underlying profile properties stay in place, so device to device sync is unaffected.
- Fixed the label text on the Details Screen Blur setting.

Features:

- Push notifications now reach Moonfin apps even when they're closed, covering Seerr activity, new media added to your library, and admin broadcasts. Admins can point at a self-hosted relay or their own FCM service account.
- Custom home rows sync across device profiles, so a row you build on one device shows up on the others, and edits and deletions carry over.
- Added a Max Days in Next Up setting.
- MDBList gained a Test Key button that shows your plan and remaining quota, a Clear Cache button, a max items limit for official lists, and Roger Ebert as a rating source.
- Added button layout sync so clients keep their player and details button layouts per device type.
- Glass and 8-bit Hero joined the admin default theme picker, along with the 8-bit Gold accent.

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed MDBList rows dropping shows, since the item cap was applied unevenly across the separate movie and show lists.
- Fixed Rotten Tomatoes critic scores never matching.
- MDBList rate limits are handled properly now, with your quota checked before syncing and partial results kept instead of overwriting good cached data.
- Ratings are filtered by the requesting device's profile instead of always using the global one.
- Fixed the Ping response casing that made clients report Seerr as not configured, and Emby media bar items now come back in the shape clients expect.
- Fixed the Emby plugin settings page never loading.
- Cancelling a Seerr request you don't have permission to cancel no longer logs you out of Seerr.
- The settings updated broadcast only fires when a save actually changed something, which stops sync loops between devices.
- Fixed the Seerr media available webhook breaking on some Jellyfin versions.

Features:

- Added password-less Seerr sign in through a Quick Connect bridge, so users who log in with Quick Connect get signed into Seerr silently.
- Added a server-side Radarr and Sonarr calendar proxy so clients can show upcoming release calendars, reachable for non-admin accounts too.
- Widened settings sync from 87 synced settings to 207, backed by new settings profile properties.
- Hardened game metadata matching with accent normalization and fuzzy suffix matching for better ROM artwork and details.
- On Emby, Moonfin web assets are now served with an explicit content type so the frontend loads correctly.
- The bundled Moonfin Web client moves up to the latest codebase, bringing a music overhaul with a Songs sublibrary and shuffle controls, a rebuilt downloads engine, a retro games library browser, Emby Skip Intro via chapter markers, and new detail and media bar controls.

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed profile corruption by writing user data atomically, with a healing pass for files corrupted before atomic writes shipped.
- Fixed Since You Watched rows for non-admin accounts by adding the server-wide API key fallback and stripping.
- Content hiding preferences now merge into the global profile instead of overwriting it.
- Fixed the Rotten Tomatoes critics rating mismatch coming from MDBList.
- Fixed Seerr sessions being evicted on 403 Forbidden responses, and stopped a failed auto-login leaving Seerr stuck as unavailable.
- Many bundled web fixes across music resume, subtitles, multi-server library browse, the media bar, Seerr requests, and focus handling.

Features:

- Moonbase now runs on Emby servers in addition to Jellyfin, bringing settings sync, the Seerr proxy, custom rows, and the rest of the plugin's backend to Emby.
- The bundled Moonfin Web client was rebuilt from the latest codebase, picking up the Modern details screen, fully custom home rows with external sources, the Seerr overhaul with SSO through the plugin, a full admin panel makeover, TV Mode on web, the Theme Store and new themes, music and book updates, and user scoped settings.
- A new Active Downloads dashboard tab shows running downloads with live transcode metrics and lets admins cancel jobs.
- Seerr push notifications with webhook provisioning and fan-out, covering request updates, approvals and denials, issue reports, and added to library notices.
- Added a retro games backend with ROM archive extraction and a games thumbnail endpoint that fetches and caches libretro art server side.
- Server-side caching for custom rows, IMDb lists, MDBList official lists enriched with TMDB posters, and TMDB studio logos.
- The full home layout can sync as sections, many more settings sync through the plugin, and applying settings to users now autosaves.
- New collection order endpoints, a library write-access check endpoint, and Jellyfin 12 compatibility via the ApiKey parameter.

Bug Fixes:

- Empty API keys sent by old clients no longer wipe stored keys during a settings merge.
- Fixed Seerr session cookie detection, the null user list when overwriting all user profiles, the Rotten Tomatoes Audience rating source mismatch, and the manifest structure.
- Many web client fixes covering track switching during transcoding, subtitles, Live TV across Jellyfin and Emby, Emby login and progress issues, pagination, overview text formatting, and theme focus colors.

Features:

- The web theme editor gained a random theme generator that builds a complete, coherent palette from a random base and accent hue, while keeping your theme id, name, and description. The theme id validation message was also clarified.

Bug Fixes:

- Media Bar trailers on web were reworked so YouTube trailer playback and advancing to the next slide now work correctly.
- Web playback sessions are now reported as stopped when you close or navigate away from the browser tab, using a page exit beacon, so they no longer linger as active on the server.
- The sidebar now follows desktop behavior in desktop browsers, instead of using the mobile layout.
- Preferences are now parsed and type coerced more robustly for web compatibility, fixing settings that could fail to load or save when stored as browser strings.
- The refresh rate switching and audio output mode settings are now hidden on the web build, where they do not apply.
- ASS and PGS subtitles now render correctly on web, with the necessary fonts bundled.

## Features

- Refreshed the Moonfin plugin, now called Moonbase, experience with the Moonfin Flutter web app, now served from `/Moonfin/Web/`.
- Replaced the older JavaScript overlay frontend with a proper web client bundled from the Flutter web project at the Moonfin-Core repo and theme assets for a smoother setup.
- Added a built-in theme editor at `/Moonfin/Web/theme/`, including admin-managed custom theme uploads and validation.
- Added discovery endpoints for plugin web startup: `/Moonfin/Discovery` and `/Moonfin/Discovery/discover`.
- Added custom theme APIs and services for listing, retrieving, uploading or replacing, deleting, and validating themes.
- Improved settings sync and admin tools with better global/profile behavior and admin broadcast support.

## Features

- Added Media Bar Enhanced support in desktop media bar settings. (#98)
- Clicking a row item now navigates to the correct library, and playback from the Continue Watching row works properly again. (#60)

## Bug Fixes

- Details page buttons were too large on some screens — they've been resized to something more reasonable. (#100)
- Clicking items from third-party home screen section plugins no longer incorrectly triggers Moonfin's custom detail page. (#96)
- Admin default settings now correctly propagate to existing users when changed. (#101)
- The Jellyseerr discover page was crashing to an error screen because the proxy was wrapping responses in an unexpected JSON envelope. That's fixed now. (#108)
- The global profile now saves reliably, the media bar state persists correctly across Moonfin and Paradox themes, and users no longer see genres or library sections they don't have access to. (#87)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Moonfin UI not loading on Jellyfin instances deployed under a reverse proxy sub-path
- Fixed Moonfin login detection using private Jellyfin API internals that could return falsy values depending on Jellyfin version, causing the plugin to never initialize
- Fixed Jellyseerr proxy (cookies, HTML/CSS rewrites, injected script) using hardcoded root-relative paths that broke under reverse proxy sub-path deployments
- Fixed Letterboxd ratings showing doubled values for entries cached prior to v1.7.0

## Features

- Added compatibility with @IAmParadox27 's  [media bar](https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-media-bar/) and [Home Screen Sections](https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections) rows
- Added support for @ranaldsgift 's  [KefinTweaks](https://github.com/ranaldsgift/KefinTweaks) rows
> [!NOTE]  
> The rows are not yet implemented in the other clients. This is a manual method that will take time but the framework for implementation is done. The media bar compatibility is for web UI only under the desktop profile

- Media bar went full screen like other clients
- Added sync mode clarity dialog box
- Added trailer overlay in details screen
- Added details blur/opacity controls and new endpoints so it syncs with clients
- Added special features, chapters, and collections in details
- Added back button and fixed details tint behavior
- Added favorite button for people details
- Added favorite/watched indicators in details and library
- Updated libraries UI
- Updated collections to display contents in release order
- Updated Moonfin plugin logo

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed details tint behavior that was causing the original jellyfin ui's backdrop image to look black
- Fixed header bar glitch that was causing the library title to scroll with users in the library
- Fixed plugin and UI not applying correctly (#60, #66, #76)
- Fixed removed media bar items that did not have a backdrop and removed items that users did not have access to.
- Fixed HDR badge truthy logic and expanded HDR range handling
- Fixed trailer button forwards to home page
- Fixed special features not showing with new details page
- Fixed Seerr invalid CSRF token (#53, #63)
- Fixed Seerr icon not showing on toolbar
- Fixed Seerr integration slowness
- Fixed /Moonfin/Settings returns 404 via reverse proxy

New Features:
- Media Bar Genre Exclusions - exclude specific genres from the media bar so items from those genres won't appear, configurable per-user and as admin defaults
- GET /Moonfin/Genres endpoint - returns all genre IDs and localized names for the genre picker

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Jellyseerr CSRF token errors causing failed authentication and proxy requests
- Fixed Jellyseerr button not appearing when navbar/sidebar initializes after config is dispatched
- Fixed media bar showing loading state indefinitely when no items are returned
- Fixed media bar active class being added when there are no items to display
- Fixed unnecessary Content-Type header on GET requests
- Fixed duplicate event listeners on collection/library picker re-renders

Improvements:
- CSRF tokens are now fetched and sent for all Jellyseerr write operations with a fallback for IP-based URLs
- Media bar loading class is now removed in error and empty states

New Features:
- Home Screen Row Ordering - drag and drop to reorder or hide home screen sections like Continue Watching, Next Up, and Latest Media
- Media Bar Collections - choose specific collections or playlists to show in the media bar instead of pulling from all libraries
- MDBList rating source labels can now be shown or hidden
- Automatic settings change when switching between users on the same device

New Endpoint:
- GET /Moonfin/MediaBar - returns media bar items based on user settings

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed playback not working from the details page
- Fixed media bar showing on pages other than the home screen
- Fixed Seerr/Jellyseerr button not appearing after settings sync
- Fixed details page interfering with media selection dialogs
- Fixed incorrect Letterboxd rating values

Improvements:

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Seerr/Jellyseerr proxy navigation - search, sidebar links, and in-app navigation no longer load indefinitely
- Fixed user settings not saving correctly - refactored settings mapping for consistency
- Fixed navbar background to use a gradient
- Fixed admin config page not appearing in Jellyfin admin sidebar

Improvements:
- Media version/quality information now displayed on details overlay
- Authentication now requires only a username for passwordless Jellyfin users

Features:

name: Authelia Authentication
description:
Authenticate your Jellyfin with Authelia, and optionally create users who do not yet exist automatically.
This plugin uses Authelia HTTP API for authentication. Unlike with an SSO plugin, this allows using the existing Jellyfin login UI and API, which is compatible with all existing Jellyfin clients.

name: Transcode Downloader
description:
Adds a quality-selection download button to Jellyfin item detail pages.  
  
Universal Repo:  
Generated: 20:28 UTC  
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ph15ch/Jellyfin-Transcode-Downloader/main/repo/manifest.json  
Github: https://github.com/ph15ch/Jellyfin-Transcode-Downloader
overview: Adds a 'Download (Transcode…)' entry to the More menu on every movie and episode detail page. Selecting it opens a quality picker — choose a bitrate tier and Jellyfin re-encodes the video server-side to H.264/AAC, streaming it to your browser with a live progress bar, or pick Original to save the unmodified source file directly. Requires the File Transformation companion plugin (>= v2.2.1.0) for permission-safe script injection.

versions.changelog:
feat: choose video and audio codec for transcoded downloads

- The quality sheet now offers a video and an audio codec picker, limited to
  what the server actually has enabled
- Downloads started from an episode list target the episode whose menu you
  opened, instead of the season or series the page is showing
- Failed or empty transcodes now report the real HTTP status instead of
  silently producing a broken file
fix: transcoding actually respects selected quality tier.
fix: i18n strings now load in the correct Jellyfin UI language (de, us, es, fr, nl, zh-cn)

Fix queue panel resetting progress bar when new items are added

Incremental DOM updates replace full re-renders so the active download's
progress bar is preserved when a second item joins the queue.

Add multi-download queue

Downloads now enqueue instead of starting immediately. Each queued item has its own cancel button; cancelling removes only that item and the next starts automatically. The bottom-right panel shows all queued items with live progress for the active one. Queue is in-memory only.
Update logo, rename console prefix to [TranscodeDownloader], fix README and manifest

Fix transcode quality tiers and stale item on first page load

- On first load, quality sheet now awaits metadata before building the
  tier list, so only valid bitrates (below source bitrate) are shown
- Quality sheet now re-derives the item ID from the URL at open time,
  preventing downloads targeting the previous movie when navigating
  between items before the hash-change event fires

Replace dropdown button with action sheet menu entry

- Remove injected select+button from the detail page
- Add 'Download (Transcode…)' entry to Jellyfin's native 'Mehr' menu
- Quality selection via a second overlay in Jellyfin's action sheet style
- Fixes reload-required bug; no longer disrupts the detail page layout

fix: show plugin logo in catalog and installed plugin detail page

- Add imageUrl to manifest.json so the catalog displays the logo
- Include logo.png in the release zip for the installed plugin detail page

rename: QuickDownload → Transcode Downloader + add logo and build CI

- Plugin display name is now "Transcode Downloader"
- All internals renamed to Jellyfin.Plugin.TranscodeDownloader
- Controller route changed to /TranscodeDownloader/ClientScript
- Added logo.png
- Added PR build workflow

Fix: force transcode to honour selected quality tier

Without allowVideoStreamCopy=false Jellyfin could direct-stream the
original file, ignoring MaxStreamingBitrate and MaxHeight entirely.
Downloads now correctly re-encode to the selected resolution and bitrate.

Fix: force transcode to honour selected quality tier

Without allowVideoStreamCopy=false Jellyfin could direct-stream the
original file, ignoring MaxStreamingBitrate and MaxHeight entirely.
Downloads now correctly re-encode to the selected resolution and bitrate.
fix: delay revokeObjectURL to prevent download failure after completion

fix: button appears on first load without page reload

Replace 20x250ms polling retry loop with a MutationObserver that fires
the moment Jellyfin's SPA renders the detail-view container. The old
loop could time out before the SPA finished hydrating, requiring a
manual page reload to see the download button.

fix: use ApiClient.getItem() for metadata fetch to avoid 401

Jellyfin 10.11 rejects api_key query-param auth on the Items endpoint,
causing the dropdown to stay empty. Switch to client.getItem() which
sends the correct Authorization header.

fix: populate dropdown after UI injection to eliminate race condition

The metadata fetch often completed before Jellyfin rendered the detail
container, so populateDropdown() exited early (select === null) without
ever setting currentItem. Clicking Download then silently did nothing.

- Move currentItem assignment before the early return in populateDropdown()
- Re-call populateDropdown() after injecting the UI if data already arrived
- Reset currentItem when navigating to a new item to avoid stale options

fix: strip Accept-Encoding/Content-Encoding to prevent compressed-body corruption

Jellyfin's static file middleware serves index.html pre-compressed when the
client advertises Accept-Encoding. The IStartupFilter middleware was buffering
those compressed bytes and writing them back with Content-Encoding: gzip still
set, causing browsers to report 'cannot decode raw data'.

Fix: remove Accept-Encoding from the request before intercepting so upstream
never activates compression; also strip Content-Encoding from the response.

fix: inject script tag via middleware — button now appears without companion plugins

The script tag is now injected by an ASP.NET Core IStartupFilter that
intercepts index.html responses in Jellyfin's HTTP pipeline. No File
Transformation plugin required, no disk writes, no timing sensitivity.

Also fixes plugin loading error in the admin UI (Plugin constructor now
calls SetAttributes).

fix: call SetAttributes in Plugin constructor so CanUninstall doesn't throw

BasePlugin (non-generic) never calls SetAttributes — only BasePlugin<T> does
in its own constructor. Without it, AssemblyFilePath stays null, and
CanUninstall throws NullReferenceException when GET /Plugins serializes the
plugin list, breaking the admin plugins page on every page load.

Fix: inject IApplicationPaths and call SetAttributes the same way BasePlugin<T>
does, giving Jellyfin a valid assembly path and data folder path.

Serve client script from controller and inject in-memory

- QuickDownloadController serves the embedded plugin.js at GET /QuickDownload/ClientScript (AllowAnonymous) so the web root never needs to be writable
- WebAssetInjector registers an in-memory File Transformation callback instead of patching index.html on disk; survives Jellyfin web updates and is auto-removed on plugin uninstall
- On-disk fallback retained for installs without File Transformation, with a loud actionable log recommending FT >= v2.2.1.0
- Base-path-aware script src for Jellyfin deployments behind a sub-path

Cache-bust plugin.js on injection

Add a ?v={assembly version} query to the injected plugin.js script tag so
browsers reload the script after a plugin upgrade instead of serving a stale
cached copy. First release cut via the new fully tag-driven release pipeline.
Initial baseline release.

versions.changelog:
v1.6.1.0
- Added language fallback. Thanks to Alexius25 on GitHub
- Removed remaining dead HiAnime code
- Removed: FlareSolverr integration. s.to has moved its provider redirector behind a Cloudflare Turnstile widget that activates per-IP for flagged egress addresses. FlareSolverr cannot solve embedded Turnstile widgets that require user interaction, so the integration was not actually helping affected users. If your server's IP is gated, route the plugin's outbound traffic through a clean proxy via the existing Proxy Server setting (SOCKS5 / HTTP supported).

v1.6.0.0
- Feature: Automatic DDoS-Guard / Cloudflare challenge bypass via optional FlareSolverr integration - solved cookies are cached and reused so the round-trip is only paid on a fresh challenge
- Feature: Movie download support for s.to and aniworld.to (#17, thanks @Alexius25)
- Feature: Force option to re-download episodes already marked as downloaded
- Feature: SOCKS5 / HTTP proxy support for outbound traffic to streaming sites
- Feature: Manual "Rebuild download history" scheduled task to resync the database with files on disk
- Fix: Movie detection and downloading reliability
- Fix: Removed legacy scheduled task that was a no-op

v1.5.3.0
- Feature: Configurable s.to base URL in plugin settings — use an alternative domain (e.g. serienstream.to) if s.to is blocked by your ISP
- Fix: ffmpeg not found on Windows servers with custom Jellyfin install locations — removed hardcoded fallback paths in favor of Jellyfin's configured ffmpeg path

v1.5.2.0
- Fix: ffmpeg not found on Windows servers — now uses Jellyfin's own ffmpeg path via IMediaEncoder with fallback to platform-specific search

v1.5.1.0
- Feature: Maintenance mode to block users from adding episodes to queue
- Feature: Priority queueing for downloads
- Feature: Display user and language for queue elements
- Feature: Better formatted statistics in history view
- Fix: Priority queue not properly displaying in the UI
- Fix: Disabled HiAnime support (service discontinuing)
- Fix: Removed bad symbols from filenames
- Fix: Build error from misplaced constant declaration
- Code cleanup: Extracted magic numbers into named constants

v1.5.0.0
- Feature: HiAnime.to support for English dubbed anime
- Feature: Sidebar access for non-admin users via File Transformation plugin
- Feature: Separated download paths per language
- Feature: Option to disable English-sub downloads for HiAnime and AniWorld
- Feature: Option to force English-dub only downloads for HiAnime
- Feature: HiAnime download merging for more accurate downloads
- Fix: HiAnime wrong episode file naming
- Fix: User downloader panel not responding if admin panel was used before
- Fix: Narrowed folder selection for HiAnime to only HiAnime-accessible titles
- Fix: Hidden irrelevant Download All button for HiAnime source titles
- Fix: Various stability improvements

v1.4.0.1
- Change default AniWorld provider to Vidmoly (faster downloads) with VOE as fallback
- Set default s.to provider to VOE
- Improved README documentation

v1.4.0.0
- Feature: s.to series download support
- Fix: Enable s.to downloader by default
- Fix: Pass season language selection to single episode downloads
- Fix: Prevent duplicate downloads when retrying a failed episode that was re-queued
- Fix: Cleanup empty directories even when download file was never created
- Fix: Cleanup base path for per-site configs, SQLite thread safety, and minor issues
- Fix: Queue display order, cleanup, and race conditions

v1.3.2.0
- Feature: Improved download queue display (downloads tab)
- Feature: Language indicator in title detail view
- Feature: More user-friendly title detail view
- Feature: Episodes refresh when navigating back to title
- Fix: Same episode could be queued multiple times
- Fix: Changing language by redownloading didn't work if language was used before
- Fix: Missing downloaded info in title detail view
- Fix: Download progress not reaching 100% in UI

v1.3.1.0
- Wider Jellyfin compatibility (10.9.0+, down from 10.11.0)
- Jellyfin plugin repository support for easy install and updates
- Automated release pipeline via GitHub Actions

v1.3.0.0
- Removed automatic update check (updates tracked via Jellyfin plugin repo)
- Fix: Unicode smart quotes in filenames normalized to ASCII
- Fix: Brackets stripped from filenames (e.g. [Final Episode])
- Repository link now always visible (hardcoded)

v1.2.0.0
- Feature: Repository link button (GitHub icon) in header
- Feature: Update check — shows banner when new version available
- Feature: Update check toggle + repo URL in settings
- Fix: Clear completed button spacing to download items

v1.1.0.0
- Security: SSRF protection — all API endpoints reject non-aniworld.to URLs
- Security: ffmpeg argument injection prevention via ArgumentList API
- Security: XSS hardening with escJs() helper
- Code cleanup: shared PathHelper, removed dead code
- Feature: Browse tab with Popular and New Releases sections
- Feature: Cover image grid with lazy loading and hover effects

v1.0.0.0
- Fix: HTML entities in episode titles fully decoded
- Feature: Download All Seasons
- Feature: Fallback provider + sidebar navigation link

v0.3.0.0
- Fix: Settings link added to main plugin page for easy access
- Fix: Downloaded status now verifies file exists on disk (handles deleted files)
- Fix: Cancelled downloads now properly clean up partial files from filesystem

v0.2.0.0
- Fix: Version now displays correctly in Jellyfin plugin list
- Fix: Download All now uses preferred language from settings + language selector
- Fix: Season switch race condition resolved
- Fix: Special characters in filenames sanitized

v0.1.0.0 - Initial release
- Search for anime on aniworld.to
- Browse seasons and episodes

- Manual map entries can now be specified either be the previous information or just using the Spotify track ID / URI, similar to how playlist URIs are handled when configuring the plugin

# Changelog

## [1.14.1.0] - 2025-09-13

### Fixed

- Excessive memory use when updating the ISRC / MusicBrainz cache in some situations

## [1.14.0.0] - 2025-09-12

### Added

- New matching method via MusicBrainz and ISRC IDs
- The plugin settings page now contains a checkbox to activate the new MusicBrainz matching method
- Support for the import of the "Liked Songs" section from Spotify

### Changed

- The current scopes of the Spotify auth token are now displayed on the plugin settings page

# Changelog

## [1.13.1.0] - 2025-08-14

### Fixed

- Fix missing progress reporting of import task
- Fix wrong parameters for some logging entries (see issue #63)
- Fix procedure to aquire auth token for alternative Spotify provider after recent changes made by Spotify (again)

# Changelog

## [1.13.0.0] - 2025-03-24

### Added

- Caching of Spotify playlists (only query the full track data if the playlist state changed)
- Caching of track matches (reuse match of a track for all occurrences across playlists)

### Fixed

- Fix procedure to aquire auth token for alternative Spotify provider after recent changes made by Spotify (again)

# Changelog

## [1.12.4.0] - 2025-03-11

### Fixed

- Fix procedure to aquire auth token for alternative Spotify provider after recent changes made by Spotify

# Changelog

## [1.12.3.0] - 2025-01-25

### Fixed

- Fix manual track map path not being found depending on the plugin location
- Fix exception handling if the manual track map does not exist yet

# Changelog

## [1.12.2.0] - 2025-01-07

### Fixed

- Fix parsing of empty artist fields when adding manual map entries

# Changelog

## [1.12.1.0] - 2024-12-08

### Fixed

- Fix missing handling of request timeouts when using the alternative Spotify provider

# Changelog

## [1.12.0.0] - 2024-12-07

### Added

- Workaround regarding the recent Spotify API changes (#48)

# Changelog

## [1.11.0.0] - 2024-11-30

### Added

- Support for manually mapping tracks between Spotify and Jellyfin (#44)

### Fixed

- Keep iterating through artists even after a first match was found (in case multiple artists with the same name exist)
- Fix exception getting user playlists due to changes in the Spotify API (#46)

# Changelog

## [1.10.0.0] - 2024-09-14

### Added

- New option to set playlists as private or public to all users

### Fixed

- Exception if Spotify returns duplicate playlists for a user

# Changelog

## [1.9.0.0] - 2024-08-25

### Added

- New setting to enable imported "progress" to be displayed in the playlist description -> #30
- New matching type to extract an album name from the track name (like 'Track [From "An Album"]') and use that for comparison

### Changed

- Updated Jellyfin dependencies to match version 10.9.9
- Switch request handling on plugin config page to use jellyfin custom fetch mechanism

# Changelog

## [1.8.1.1] - 2024-06-21

### Fixed

- Include missing Fastenshtein dependency in build artifacts

# Changelog

## [1.8.1.0] - 2024-05-19

### Fixed

- Broken API endpoints (due to authorisation policy changes in Jellyfin introduced in 10.9)

# Changelog

## [1.8.0.0] - 2024-05-17

### Added

- Support for Jellyfin 10.9
- New configurable flag for each playlist whether or not to recreate it from scratch each time the task runs
- New matching type "fuzzy checking" for track and album names

### Changed

- "Ignore Parentheses" now treats [] the same as ()
- Some rework of the track matching process (again); the plugin now tries to find all potential matches first and then decides a "best fit" track name

# Changelog

## [1.7.2.0] - 2024-03-29

### Fixed

- Accept matches where Spotify uses a different track syntax than metadata providers (e.g. "Track Name - Super Remix" on Spotify and "Track Name (Super Remix)" on MusicBrainz) if at least match level `Ignore Case + Punctuation` is used

# Changelog

## [1.7.1.0] - 2024-03-18

### Changed

- Extend logging information / debug possibilities

## [1.7.0.0] - 2024-03-10

### Changed

- If a track / album / artist contains text in parentheses, this content will be used as another match candidate (e.g. to match tracks that have an english translation of a foreign name)

### Fixed

- Fix broken track matching if multiple artists of a track exist in Jellyfin, but the track is not located under the first existing artist
- Fix not matching tracks if their album is not a direct child of their artist and (for whatever reason) only detectable via the album artist

- Use all (album) artists from Spotify to check whether a matching artist exists in Jellyfin, not just the first one

name: StarTrack
description:
Community star ratings for movies and TV shows — stored privately on your Jellyfin server.  
  
Universal Repo:
